generation_prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: an original editorial photograph for an enterprise software website, one complete photograph with no collage.
Input images: the three attached photographs are broad visual-appearance references ONLY, not edit targets. Use a similar general range of light to light-medium skin tones, natural brown/dark-brown hair, ordinary young-adult features and understated clothing. Invent entirely NEW fictional adult people with distinct facial proportions and identities. Do not copy any reference person's face one-to-one, do not reproduce a recognizable individual, and do not reuse the source poses, backgrounds, logos or event text.
Photographic style: an unposed moment from a real professional photo shoot, natural skin pores and fine hair, realistic proportions and hands, modest facial asymmetry, subtle natural expressions, authentic workplace details, soft daylight, restrained neutral colour grading, slight photographic grain. All people are clearly adults aged roughly 25–35.
Constraints: no logos, watermarks, slogans, readable text, real brand identifiers or personal information. No duplicate faces, plastic skin, mannequin poses, exaggerated smiles, uncanny eyes, malformed fingers, CGI, illustration, excessive HDR or artificial lens glow.
Primary request: create a wide 16:9 natural team-workshop photograph. Four young adult software colleagues, two men and two women, collaborate around one open laptop and a simple paper workflow sketch at a modern light oak meeting table in a bright, tasteful office. One colleague calmly indicates a step on the paper while the others pay attention; the gestures must make physical sense. The laptop screen is angled away and contains no readable UI. A pale wall, glass partitions, a plant and softly blurred daylight windows provide quiet depth.
Composition: landscape 16:9, medium-wide eye-level camera, natural 35–50mm photographic perspective. Keep the main interaction and distinct faces in the middle and right two-thirds, with quieter office/table space at the left. Keep people and hands comfortably within the frame. Candid collaboration, not a lineup or staged group portrait.
Wardrobe and mood: plain navy, charcoal, muted olive and cream casual professional clothes, no uniforms or branded shirts. Focused, friendly, capable; relaxed restrained expressions. Use soft side window light and believable contact shadows. Aim for a high-quality 2048 × 1152 or equivalent 16:9 master.

Primary request: create a wide 16:9 natural editorial photograph in a bright contemporary clinical corridor. Two fictional adult colleagues, a female clinician or clinical administrator in simple pale-blue scrubs with a light white coat and a male operations colleague in a plain navy knit layer, quietly review a tablet together. Both are approximately 30–35 and have original, distinct faces broadly consistent with the reference appearance range, without recreating any reference identity. The woman holds the tablet naturally; the man looks attentively at it with one relaxed hand nearby. Show a practical coordination moment, not treatment.

Bright pale walls, frosted interior glazing and soft corridor depth; diffuse daylight and natural, restrained expressions. Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide editorial website photography for an enterprise banking workflow page. Generate a NEW photograph, not an edit or recreation of the input photos. The three input photos are only references for a general range of visible human traits: natural-looking adults with brown or dark-blond hair, a mixture of short and medium-length hair, ordinary real-life facial texture and a young technical-team feel. Invent DIFFERENT fictional faces; change facial geometry, hairlines, eyes and noses, and do not reproduce any particular person's likeness one-for-one. Scene: a calm, modern bank-advisory office with floor-to-ceiling windows and warm grey walls; three adult business analysts, two men and one woman around 28–38, reviewing a paper form and an open laptop together at a wooden table. Subtle business-casual clothes in charcoal, navy and cream. No bank logos, no visible personal data, no readable text or brand marks on screens. The mood is thoughtful and collaborative, not a sales handshake. Natural side daylight, true skin texture, restrained neutral colors, documentary 35mm photography with gentle depth of field. Wide 16:9 photograph, ideally 2048 by 1152 pixels. Show the room and desk, with faces clustered in the central 45 percent so a mobile crop still works; do not crop heads or hands. No graphics, borders, subtitles, watermarks, cloned faces, uncanny eyes or plastic skin.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide photographic hero for an enterprise utilities workflow website. Generate a NEW documentary photograph. The three supplied photos are reference only for a general human appearance, with natural adult faces, short or medium brown/dark-blond hair and an approachable technical-team character. Create visibly DIFFERENT fictional adults, not exact recreations of any people in the references: different face proportions, hairlines and features. Scene: two utility field engineers, a man and a woman roughly 28–38, discussing a rugged tablet at a solar-and-electricity facility on the edge of a green landscape, with solar panels and a small transformer station softly receding into the distance. Wear believable clean work jackets in muted navy and safety helmets; no company branding. A third engineer is distant and out of focus. Natural late afternoon light, overcast soft highlights, restrained green and steel-blue palette, credible equipment, subtle documentary grain, realistic hands and skin. Wide 16:9 composition, ideally 2048x1152; keep the main two engineers in the central region with visible context around them and room for a small mobile crop. No readable text, no logos, no watermark, no dramatic disaster, no neon/futuristic equipment, no exact cloned faces.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide editorial photograph for a retail operations website. Generate a NEW image using the three supplied photographs ONLY as a loose reference for the range of human appearance: natural adult faces, some brown/dark-blond hair, short and medium haircuts, relaxed technical-team character. Invent distinct fictional people and do not reproduce the identity or precise face of anyone in the input photos. Scene: two adult retail operations colleagues, a woman and a man around 27–38, reviewing an inventory tablet beside tidy shelving at the junction of a contemporary retail store and its stockroom. A third colleague quietly checks a shelf in the far background. Natural business-casual clothes with a plain olive work apron on one person. Products are simple unbranded boxes, glassware and household goods with no readable labels. Clean but believable workspace, soft window light, warm grey and light oak tones, restrained color, natural candid posture and subtle expressions. High-quality realistic documentary photograph, 35mm lens look, no excessive bokeh. Wide 16:9 format, ideally 2048x1152, main two faces and the tablet within the middle 45 percent for responsive crops; keep full heads and natural hands. No logos, signage, captions, watermarks, repeated faces or beauty retouching.

Primary request: create a new wide 16:9 environmental photograph of a live technical telecommunications operations room. Three adult engineers, approximately 27–40, work together across a long modern desk. One seated woman in a plain charcoal shirt is checking a realistic operational dashboard, a seated man in a muted navy overshirt is looking at a second screen, and another man in a pale neutral knit layer stands nearby listening and pointing calmly at a single display. Each has a new distinct fictional face in the broad appearance range of the references. They are technical engineers, not a posed customer-service call-centre lineup.
Environment and screens: a credible network operations workspace with a restrained wall of monitors, modest server/network equipment visible deeper in the room, cables routed neatly and ordinary keyboards and desk objects. Screens show plausible abstract line charts, network health diagrams and small unreadable interface elements, with no legible labels, company branding or flashy science-fiction graphics.
Composition: landscape 16:9, medium-wide environmental view from a natural diagonal eye-level angle, 35mm photographic perspective. Keep the people in the middle 60% of the frame and away from the edges, with room around heads for narrower responsive crops. The room and equipment should remain a meaningful part of the photograph. People occupy about half the frame height, not large close-up portraits. Soft daylight from high side windows balances muted cool-blue screen glow and quiet amber practical lighting. Realistic concentrated expressions and natural posture. Aim for 2048 × 1152 or equivalent 16:9.

Primary request: create a new wide 16:9 candid environmental photograph of five adult product and engineering teammates collaborating informally in a warm modern workplace. This is a broad architectural team scene, distinct from a tight workshop photo around one laptop. Two colleagues sit at a workbench while three stand nearby in conversation, with one referring to a notebook and another listening. All five are new distinct fictional adults, roughly 26–38, with a natural mix of plain navy, charcoal, olive and cream casual professional clothing. Include different normal hair lengths and subtle individual facial features. No identical faces, no source-portrait recreation, no standing in a posed line.
Environment: an airy contemporary workspace with high ceilings, generous glass partitions, warm timber surfaces, restrained metal details, plants and large daylight windows. A few closed notebooks and ordinary laptops may be present, with screens angled away and no readable text. Use a whiteboard only as an indistinct background with no legible writing. The architecture and empty surrounding space should occupy more than half the image.
Composition and use: landscape 16:9, wide editorial environmental camera view with believable 35mm perspective. The group is in the middle ground, centrally grouped but comfortably inset from every edge, with clear space above heads and on both sides. Keep faces small enough that generous responsive cropping and website text/card overlays remain possible. The people occupy about 40–50% of frame height. Natural engaged expressions, credible hands and a candid moment rather than a staged advertising pose. Soft daylight, warm amber practical lights and restrained teal shadows, subtle film-like grain and honest skin texture. Aim for 2048 × 1152 or equivalent 16:9.
